notes.title: Tilt Five™ Support Now Available!
notes.content:
[h3]Time to put your glasses on because Rise of Humanity is available NOW for the Tilt Five™ augmented reality (AR) glasses! 😎🤓 [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/76e203cb1da53c7562973b2050c3bf3a7bcdb2d4.jpg[/img]

If you are an owner of a pair of Tilt Five™ glasses, the time has come for you to experience [i]Rise of Humanity[/i] from a new perspective in augmented reality (AR)! Get closer to the robot busting action, hang out with holographic bunnies and guide your heroes to victory on the top of your table! 

[h3]How To Play? [/h3]
Make sure your Tilt Five™ glasses are connected to your computer and properly setup. Once the game updated, you will get the option to chose between "Play Rise of Humanity" and "Play the Tilt Five™ version of Rise of Humanity", select the Tilt Five™ option and you are ready to go! Easy, isn't it? :) 

Disclaimer: The Title Five™ version of the game does not have the content from Update 2 implemented yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/704123d79f7caae3f7f24e3779e0cca4ed8f80f6.jpg[/img]

Want to know more about Tilt Five™? [url=https://www.tiltfive.com/]Check out their website[/url] and check out this trailer!👇
[previewyoutube=Fzr-IeyWj40;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 2 OUT NOW!🚀A new playable character, new enemy and a new environment!
notes.content:
[h3]Not too long ago we released our first update, and since then we’ve been working hard to bring you a bunch of new content. Now, the second update is here [b]WITH A 20% DISCOUNT![/b] Here’s the full list of what’s in it.
[/h3]

[h3]Check out our brand new trailer for Update 2:[/h3]

[previewyoutube=biZuQouo6fs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New playable character: Danny[/h2]

Danny might look like a punk, but he's actually a former acclaimed showman that excels in illusions and manipulation. His cards are tailored to divert the enemy but also to manipulate the deck of his allies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/1a43859c92408972e11d2e589f112fd56d463f0f.gif[/img]

Let's look at two new cards:
[list]
[*]Shadow Clone - Deploy a holographic copy of yourself and use him to divert enemies or even attack them! Be warned: one Crusher attack and your clone's a goner. This card has a lot of nice combos to try out, so catch them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/731041f792a3b3bec388030d7f4d25a0e0101a14.gif[/img]

[*]The Great Unveil - Ever wanted to play an enemy card? Now you can! With Danny's The Great Unveil card you can take a look at an enemy's hand and use one of their annoying moves against them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/a86b93d947b3941665950c3197afd6c9452b01a4.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2]New enemy type: MARV![/h2]

The MARV - or the chicken with a bazooka as we like to call it in the office - is the first ranged enemy in the game, which means it will shake up tactics quite a lot. No more hiding behind turrets or walls, this thing comes straight for your soul.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/39c4607eb1050414b8bd1f076c8998f5ac63d59d.gif[/img]

Let's look at one of the MARV's cards:

[list]
[*]Vigilance - This is a reaction card, meaning the MARV will use it as soon as it sees you move in a 2 hex radius around it. Then of course, it will reward you with some explosive presents.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/e3b669b1a0fec188966df7e4fb2678e22d6b83d0.gif[/img]
[/list][h3]
...and many more new cards![/h3] 

[h2]The Warehouse, a new environment to play in![/h2]
We also conjured up the Warehouse, a magical place made for bot-clobbering. This abandoned multi-floor jungle of walkways and vines creates the most claustrophobic experience in [i]Rise of Humanity [/i]yet. The level features a more narrow layout compared to the already existing levels. This also makes the Illusionist shine!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/bf3a704325c039793986dc8bf5d57452046827ef.gif[/img]

[h2]New Daily Challenge Missions![/h2]

The daily challenges just got more challenging! More enemies - yes, including the MARV -, more demanding mission goals, more tension in general.

[b]Four challenge types will possibly get you into full-on nail-biting mode:[/b]

ESCAPE – Be a sci-fi Houdini and make your way to an ever-changing escape zone while dodging robot raids. All heroes need to escape, so make sure to bring some elbow grease.

DESTROY – Airborne AI shuttles dropped some deadly bombs that eradicate your whole team if you’re too late. Get going and wreck them all before time runs out!

SURVIVE – The robot horde has spotted you, but help is on its way. Can you stand your ground for long enough without getting annihilated? Pro defense tactics are required.

KILL THEM ALL – Classic mode. Just wipe out every robot and claim victory. Simple as that.

[h2]A brand new animated limited edition card[/h2]
Our community over on discord voted on the Deploy Turret card to be turned into an animated one. So here it is! Make sure to play the game between March 31, 2022 and May 31, 2022 to claim your animated Deploy Turret card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/bc137e8fcabb25dcc2bc6e2b9b72553fed64d2bd.gif[/img]

[h2]Tweaks and Fixes[/h2]
And of course a lot of bugfixes and tweaks based on your reports and suggestions! Just to name a few: 

[list]
[*] Polish language added thanks to our community member [h3]vito74m / A100N[/h3]
[*] Quality-of-life improvements of the gameplay camera
[*] Fixed numerous bugs that would cause the game to not respond
[/list]

[b]...and much more smaller bugfixes and tweaks![/b]

[h3]Confident of your robot-ravaging skills? Try to get first on the monthly leaderboard! There’s a new challenge every day! [b]Don't forget there is a 20% discount active for a limited time![/b] [/h3]

notes.title: Can You Make It With a Random Deck?
notes.content:
With the new battle conditions we added to the game, your heroes definitely have their work cut out for them. Not only can all Daily Challenge maps be engulfed in fog of war now, hiding all enemies from sight. It's also possible that your heroes end up with completely random decks, with the '52 pickup' battle condition. This way, you may have to rethink your entire strategy to make use of the cards you get. Here are some tips to help you do so!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/qJNEosuhWsp4OBQMtV/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2]Take the best & leave the rest
[/h2]

With the random decks, your heroes may get some cards that are, well, a bit useless in a battle. So you might want to be tactical and focus on the cards that you can really make use of. It's a good idea to upgrade and remove unwanted cards as soon as possible. This way, there's a higher chance of a damaging card appearing in your hand.


[h2]Be strategic with the toolboxes[/h2]

There are two ways to get new cards in Rise of Humanity. One, is to slay Crushers and the other is to discover the map to loot toolboxes. If you find one of these treasure chests, let the ally with the weakest deck loot them!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/yJQuSWQUxFPd39TXFb/giphy.gif[/img]


[h2]Slay some Crushers[/h2]

Because it's fun, but also because it will give each of your heroes a new card.


[h2]Choose wisely[/h2]

So you've destroyed a Crusher or looted a toolbox. But what now? When it comes to selecting the winning card out of the three options, you should also consider what the mission goal is.
If it's a Kill All Enemies mission it's best to go for the attack cards that deal a good amount of damage or can affect more than one enemies. For the Escape mission, getting a Last Resort card may be a good idea as well!

Looking for more tips? [url=http://discord.gg/riseofhumanity]Join our Discord[/url] to discuss strategy with us and our community!

notes.title: Update OUT NOW with Limited Edition Card & New Challenges
notes.content:
[b]Since we released the game in Early Access this October, we’ve been working hard to bring you a bunch of new content. Now, [u]the first update[/u] is here, just in time for Christmas! Here’s the full list of what’s coming.[/b]

[h3]Check out our Update Trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=1oLmhJeXAEY;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]NEW MISSION GOALS[/h2]

First off, your heroes will be facing new challenges. With the update, we added two new mission goals to the Daily Challenges, namely:

[h3]DESTROY! [/h3]
Your heroes will have to race against time and eliminate bioweapons the AI has dropped in their area. The clock’s ticking, so you better make a run for it!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/QJ5S4s4qZSWXObNlt7/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]SURVIVE![/h3]
Those of you who already played the game know the third mission, where our crafty inventor, Su, has to spend an excruciating [i]seven[/i] rounds among a horde of deadly machines and make it out in one piece. With the new update, you will also be able to play missions like that in the Daily Challenges. Watch out for reinforcements - the new enemies that will keep appearing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/ce5a74fe2400206a5447b84aca05c08a0eeeabd6.jpg[/img]

[u]If you haven’t tried our Daily Challenges yet:[/u] The Daily Challenge Mode is an extra game mode in [i]Rise of Humanity[/i]. It will give you three randomly generated missions that change every day, with random battle conditions and characters, set in randomly chosen levels.

When in the main menu, click the Daily Challenge Mode button. What you’ll see is the missions, heroes and battle conditions chosen for the day:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/9cFcFMS2rjkjwveI2O/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2]NEW BATTLE CONDITIONS[/h2]

The update comes with a new collection of these battle conditions, which are various factors that make completing the Daily Challenges harder or easier. For example, your heroes may come across inverted hot zones – or NOT ZONES – that will have reverse effects instead of their normal ones. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/XZGP88XVaAdSxzR3bg/giphy.gif[/img]

On occasion, you may face a more challenging quest with all Daily missions being engulfed in a mysterious fog of war, hiding all those deadly enemies from your sight. And if you’re (very) unlucky, it might just become easier to wake up those nasty enemies… 

There’s also gonna be a brand new battle condition that has your allies get a completely random deck of cards - so better put your tactical skills to work!

To summarize, these are the new battle conditions coming with the update:
[list]
[*] [b]Fog of War:[/b] All missions in the Daily Challenges have fog of war. 
[*] [b]Visionary:[/b] Enemies' wakeup range is larger. 
[*] [b]Not Zones:[/b] All hot zones have inverted effects. 
[*] [b]52 Pickup:[/b] Your allies get a random deck of cards. 
[/list]

[h2]NEW BATTLE GOALS[/h2]

The update has a bunch of new battle goals as well. These are various objectives your heroes must complete to gain skill points. Here’s the list of what you can expect:

[list]
[*] [b]Floor is Lava:[/b] Step on a set number of hot zones. 
[*] [b]Omnivore:[/b] Attack a set number of enemies.
[*] [b]Lily-Livered:[/b] Disengage from a set number of enemies.
[*] [b]Party Pooper:[/b] Get a set number of debuffs on an enemy.
[*] [b]Pretty Pushy:[/b] Push or pull allies, enemies, and deployables a set number of hexes. 
[/list]


[h2]DIFFERENT WEATHER[/h2]

We also have rain, snow, and other weather conditions in the environments, such as these ones:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Vvt0xAzPRG5cjoU28K/giphy.gif[/img]

And that’s not all.


[h2]GOLD CARD SKINS[/h2]

From now on, we’ll literally turn a card of yours into gold every time you beat the Daily Challenges! 
The gold cards will look like this one:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/usAVDcVX4BySS6HCZZ/giphy.gif[/img]

And needless to say, you get to keep them after the holidays as well! But remember, you have to win the Daily Challenges in order to get these. Here are some tips and tricks on how you can master them: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1048530/view/3070886183425970463

 [h2]LIMITED EDITION CARD[/h2]

We will also have a Special Limited Edition animated card for people who have the Early Access or purchase it during the Steam Winter Sale (from 22 December until 5 January). 

It will look like this:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/C9U5uKCRTvrelala8M/giphy.gif[/img]


Don’t forget, you [b]must log in to the game from 22 December until 5 January to get this special card[/b]!

[h2]TWITCH CONNECTION[/h2]

A special surprise for streamers: the first [i]Rise of Humanity[/i] update comes with a possibility to connect to Twitch so your viewers can vote on which card you choose in the game!

We also made tweaks, optimizations, performance improvements, bug fixes and other small additions. Many thanks for your help and feedback on these, much appreciated!


But that’s not all. [b][i]Rise of Humanity[/i] is taking part in the Steam Winter Sale[/b] as well, with a 20% discount from 22 December until 5 January.

We’re pretty excited about this update and we hope you are too! Let us know how you like all these new additions on our Steam discussions or [url=discord.gg/riseofhumanity]join our Discord[/url] to discuss it with the community!

Stay tuned, ‘cause we’ll be back with new updates (soon). Until then, happy holidays and have fun slaying those nasty robots!

notes.title: First Update Coming Next Week!
notes.content:
[b]It was only two months ago that we launched [i]Rise of Humanity [/i]in Early Access. Now that the holidays are nigh, we’d like to surprise you with our first content update. What can you expect?[/b]


[h2]Thrilling New Challenges [/h2]

The update will add [b]brand new mission types[/b] to the Daily Challenge Mode. This extra game mode in [i]Rise of Humanity[/i] basically gives you three randomly generated missions that change every day, with random battle conditions and characters, set in randomly chosen levels.

Stay tuned for more details, we’ll give you a hint until then:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/f2s8e66BdAqEBOqXS5/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2]New Battle Goals & Battle Conditions[/h2]

In the Daily Challenges, your heroes complete ever changing missions facing various factors that make their jobs harder or easier. The update comes with [b]a new collection of these battle conditions[/b]. More on that later…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/PAJrZ8BKGtXyfTQfjd/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2]Limited Edition Card[/h2]

The update comes with a [b]Special Edition animated card[/b] for people who have the Early Access or purchase it during the Winter Sale. Can you guess which card will be the animated one?

[h2]Gold Card Skins[/h2]

Beating a Daily Challenge will turn a random card in the game gold. So those who practice with the Daily Challenges every day will not only climb our leaderboards with their high scores but will have a deck made of gold (literally).

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/wXkhps8YeRkPI1rGLM/giphy.gif[/img]

...and more.

That’s all we can say for now, but we’ll be back next week with more details. 

Stay tuned, and [url=discord.gg/riseofhumanity]join our Discord community[/url] to get the news first-hand!

notes.title: Coming to Early Access: Alex, a hero with a deep hatred against the machines
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/yDUcAEnliMy4OxphIh/giphy.gif[/img]

The ruthless Alex is one of the most controversial characters in the game with a very bleak vision of the world. As a healer, they are very caring to their loved ones, but they have a lot of anger boiling inside them that make them rather dangerous.

Having lost everything dear to them in the raid on a refugee camp, they vowed not to rest until they destroy the AI that has taken over the world. Their outspoken hatred to the machines make them a rather complex hero – they respect Su’s authority but reject it at the same time due to their very different views.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/PnEVr8MqbNEs58RSD1/giphy.gif[/img]

They have a deep knowledge of robots and how to slowly destroy them, which they use quite often in battle – making the crushers and other enemy machines disintegrate with corrosion.

Some of Alex’s special cards:
[list]
[*] [b]Healing Spray [/b]– heals your allies in a cone in a range of one hex.
[*] [b]Deploy Health Beacon[/b] – this little deployable heals yourself and every ally in a one hex range, can be very useful in a battle! It will give all your friends standing in its range 3 health at the beginning of the turn.
[*] [b]Pocket Gun[/b] – this powerful little weapon will deal two damage to your enemies from two hexes away.
[*] [b]Acid Spray[/b] – this one applies corrosion to all your enemies in a cone with a range of one.
[/list]

Stay tuned to find out more about the other heroes and enemies of the game, we'll be back with a new introduction next week!

[b]Pocket Gun[/b] – this powerful little weapon will deal two damage to your enemies from two hexes away.
[b]Acid Spray[/b] – this one applies corrosion to all your enemies in a cone with a range of one.

notes.title: Demo with the new gameplay available now!
notes.content:
We're very excited to announce that we're releasing a free demo for the Steam Next Fest today at 19h CEST! It will include the first two levels and brand new gameplay, as well as two playable characters.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lqWkK36MzE2vj0UHdN/giphy.gif[/img]

The game works with a [b]new movement system[/b] now, each character can move six hexes without having to discard any cards. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Kx7opPwlaWW1Yef04i/giphy.gif[/img]

We also have a [b]brand new energy system[/b]: the characters start their turn with three energy points that they have to exchange in order to use their cards. Each card costs a certain amount of energy ranging from 0 to 5 based on their rarity (the more ''common'' the card is, the less energy it will cost.) You can see the energy cost on top of each card.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/eJO487x3vnJ8rLnysj/giphy.gif[/img]

From now on, you will also find [b]hotzones[/b] on the playing field. By walking into one of the hexes with hotzones, your heroes can do various things such as:
[list]
[*]  Charge their energy
[*]  Increase their health
[*]  Get more cards - but for a price...
[*]  Increase ranged attack damage
[*]  Reduce the energy cost of their cards.
[/list]

Curious for more? Download the free demo to try out the new game mechanics and hotzones!

notes.title: New gameplay, energy system & hotzones in Rise of Humanity
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/9e7b7b5694a248f83207aa53782a93f5b26799fe.jpg[/img]

A couple of weeks ago, we have started playing around with different versions of a fog of war in Rise of Humanity. At the same time, we've been working on some other exciting gameplay updates.
 
We've also introduced a [b]brand new energy system[/b] to make the game more tactical! From now on, [b]each hero will start their turn with three energy points that they have to exchange in order to use their cards[/b]. Each card will cost a certain amount of energy ranging from 0 to 5 based on their rarity (the more ''common'' the card is, the less energy it will cost.)

This is not the only change. On the playing field, you will find a brand-new gameplay mechanic called hotzones. By walking into one of the hexes with hotzones, your heroes can do various things from [b]increasing their energy to getting more cards[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/73945779348eaec9e82dccee4bf18c6c0734bb68.jpg[/img]
 
The one in the middle of the picture above for example will [b]give you plus two health points[/b], while the one on the image below will [b]increase the damage caused to an enemy by ranged attacks of your character.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/6a1ca63aca6826c6270234b3bd724af2e9c1c3fd.jpg[/img]
 
We do have some tricky ones though. The hotzone on the image below for example will give you, so be careful with walking into that one!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/bf6c1674626c6c58f5faa3cb16c08713f9348126.jpg[/img]

Not all of them come with such a price though - the one in the right side of the picture below will reduce the energy cost of your cards by one, which could come incredibly handy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/52c3cde6bfcd754053cafd6ad6cf1ada39405201.jpg[/img]
 
To summarize, here are five things that you can do with the new hotzones:
1. Charge your energy 
2. Increase your health 
3. Get more cards - but for a price...
4. Increase ranged attack damage 
5. Reduce the energy cost of your cards.

We have a lot of updates to share in the next couple of weeks, so stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Find out about the exciting updates coming to the game today!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to share some of the new updates coming to the game with the new build, including a cool new hero, new cards and skills. [url=https://discord.com/invite/riseofhumanity]Join our Discord to request a key[/url], you can take part in our tournament and watch us play the brand new version live today from 6pm CET!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/92e95d58a7bafb1e92d89dba676d7c8a46e539ad.png[/img]

[b]A brand new character[/b]

All we can tell you for now is that she is a badass lady who goes by the name ‘’Engineer’’ and who knows how to use bots and turn them against the enemy! With her incredible technical skills she will be a powerful new asset to your team of heroes for sure!

[b]Powerful new cards[/b]

Our Engineer has some crafty tricks up her sleeve that she can use against them nasty bots. With her ‘’Stomp’’ move, she can literally trample the enemy using her own bot, dealing 2 damage points to her victim. Be careful though, because she will also push the attacked enemy one hex away with this powerful combat move! 

The Engineer can also deploy a Mobile Mine and a Turret, both of which are smaller devices that help her in battle: the first one is a target-seeking mine that explodes on impact and blows up enemies, while the Turret is a powerful tool for range attacks.

[b]A new location, beautiful scenery, but wait…[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/6c42f3981f0e6ad5da48d8451708967f18b0ecf6.png[/img]

We have already shared some screenshots of the Biofarm location and now we’re happy to share that from tomorrow, it's playable in story mode and in the daily challenges as well! Feast your eyes on its stunning scenery, but be aware that it is filled with vicious bots, nasty robot puppies and sneaky drones! 

[b]A few (very useful) new features[/b]

We have also added some exciting new skills: 
[list]
[*] Every character can now lock a card and keep it for the next round.
[*] You can now discard one of your cards to move, even if you have no movement cards in your hand. 
[*] You can also sacrifice one of the cards you don’t need and switch it for a randomly selected card with a melee attack – which can definitely come in handy with the many wicked enemies around!
[/list]

We have also done some bug fixes, added more sounds to the game and made several improvements on lighting, hexes and many more!

Curious to find out more? [url=https://discord.com/invite/riseofhumanity]Join our Discord[/url] where we share some exclusive details and stream the game today!

notes.title: Play the new demo now
notes.content:
[h3]Play the new demo today![/h3]

Since the release of our first demo during the Steam Game Festival in June, we have been hard at work and are eager to show you what we haven been working.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/93827419a46e183c81ff4e83b2b868088353a2d8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Daily Challenge[/h3]

While the previous demo showed you the Rise of Humanity story-mode, we now introduce you to the Daily Challenge mode.

In our Daily Challenge, you play through 3 randomly generated missions with 3 heroes with a daily generated set of 3 Battle Conditions, modifiers that will make the challenge easier or harder!

Playing the Daily Challenge gives you a score on our Leaderboards, where players can compete daily and monthly.

[h3]Win a T-shirt in our Daily Challenge[/h3]

To celebrate this significant addition to the game, we will be holding a [b]competition on Friday (23rd)[/b].

All you have to do is [b]play the Daily Challenge[/b] on Friday. The highest ranking players will get a [b]Rise of Humanity T-shirt[/b] sent to them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/0aa096086e709a94c41735f225729f80225196dc.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other features[/h3]

If you played the previous demo, you will notice quite a few other improvements:
[list]
[*] The addition of a new environment, the Quarry.
[*] A lot of new Quality-of-Life features, including
[/list]
 [olist]
[*] an improved UI,
[*] easily recognisable icons for game penalties and bonuses,
[*] the possibility to check opponent card decks
[*] and of course, a lot of bug fixing
[/olist]

That said, the game is still only an alpha demo and will contain bugs, that might cause hangs.

We hope you will enjoy the game. If you do, come say hi on our [url=https://discord.gg/riseofhumanity]Discord[/url] and tell us what you like about the game, what you are looking forward to and...show off your Daily Challenge high score :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35939359/b2b443b71195b392b0f9b47e414e979f1f2ffd28.jpg[/img]
